method: Five randomized rounds of three modes per project after one unmeasured warmup. Clean outputs before every run, warm caches and downloads, six jobs, ccache and Cargo incremental compilation disabled. Wall time includes trace writing. Compiler traces disabled. Release build of collection-controls implementation, no diagnostic instrumentation.
